purpose: Test whether causal just-in-time parent-tail admission can retain V160 throughput while recovering part of V159's latency/QPR benefit without long speculative reservation.

paper_sequence_gate.homogeneous_middle_and_high_historical_b: retain unchanged and do not rerun

causal_diagnosis.collector_constraint: The frozen PreAllSched collector exposes a child only after every direct parent has an assigned node. Rejecting every deeper nonterminal stage prevents completion-proximal descendants from becoming eligible until very late.
causal_diagnosis.mechanism: Permit any short nonterminal child only after every unfinished direct parent has demonstrated positive service in the immediately preceding frame and its predicted remaining frames, computed from that realized service, are no greater than the child's immutable cold-start frames. This propagates causally down a chain while limiting reservation lead to one cold-start interval.

frozen_thresholds.queue_density_definition: current pending plus runnable tasks divided by node count
frozen_thresholds.remaining_work_definition: sum over unfinished functions of cpu/mean_node_cpu + cold_start_frames/1000 + output_mb/1000
frozen_thresholds.jit_boundary: maximum predicted unfinished-direct-parent remaining frames is at most the child immutable cold_start_frames

jit_parent_tail_definition.current_observation: RunningTask.left_calc from the current scheduler snapshot
jit_parent_tail_definition.previous_observation: the same task's RunningTask.left_calc from exactly the immediately preceding scheduler frame
jit_parent_tail_definition.multiple_parent_rule: all unfinished direct parents must pass; compare the maximum predicted remaining frames with child cold_start_frames
active_parent_requirements: the parent is assigned to a node
the assigned parent container exists and is Running
the request task exists in that container
the task input data are fully received
both consecutive left_calc values are finite and nonnegative
realized service is strictly positive apart from the existing numerical epsilon guard
fail_closed: missing assignment, container or resident task
jit_parent_tail_definition.state_update: Evaluate all candidates against an immutable previous-frame map, then replace that map with a deterministic current-frame snapshot only after collection completes.

single_mechanism_change_from_v159.ready_players: unchanged: admit after every parent completes
single_mechanism_change_from_v159.terminal_pipeline_players: unchanged: admit when every parent has an assigned node at every queue density
single_mechanism_change_from_v159.nonterminal_short_players: below queue density 8 and remaining work at most 5.5, replace unconditional admission with the preregistered realized-service parent-tail rule
unchanged: queue-density threshold 8.0 and exact V155 scoring router

diagnostic_selection_rule.evaluation: Replace only V155 E09, E18 and E20 with V161 and recompute the unchanged complete E01-E20 gates.
diagnostic_selection_rule.throughput_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins, including at least 2 of 3 diagnostic wins
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_mean_gate: both QPR conventions strictly greater than OCS 0.055577160345697
diagnostic_selection_rule.qpr_paired_gate: at least 12 of 20 wins with 20 of 20 finite-only values
diagnostic_selection_rule.joint_diagnostic_pass: every listed gate passes without editing this plan
diagnostic_selection_rule.failure: retain all three valid V161 diagnostics, retire V161 and continue mechanism analysis without running the other seventeen
